# `aitbc simulate ai-jobs`

Simulate AI job submissions and completions.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc simulate ai-jobs [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--jobs` | integer | `10` | no | Number of AI jobs to simulate |
| `--models` | text | `text-generation,image-generation` | no | Available models (comma-separated) |
| `--duration-range` | text | `30-300` | no | Job duration range in seconds (min-max) |
| `--delay` | float | `1.0` | no | Delay between job status checks (seconds) |
| `--seed` | integer | — | no | Seed for deterministic simulation (default: live) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc simulate ai-jobs
```
